# UX, Localization & Branding Checklist: German, Brandable Event-First Calendar UI

**Purpose**: Validate the clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability of the user-facing language, event hierarchy, disclosure behavior, branding configuration, and responsive control requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all application-owned UI surfaces explicitly included in the German-language requirement, including loading, empty, error, stale, partial-data, accessibility, and document-title copy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 Are deployment inputs, fallback behavior, trimming, bounds, and plain-text rendering all specified for both title environment variables? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Are event-card requirements defined for title, time, optional details, expansion state, missing location, and location links? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are compact default, expanded, active-filter, loading, error, stale, empty, and no-snapshot states defined for secondary controls and refresh utility? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is “dominant event” clarified through document order and relative visual prominence rather than left as a subjective design adjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Is the visual separation of adjacent event cards described with objectively reviewable boundary and spacing expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is the click-to-expand affordance explicitly required to be visible before activation and understandable in German for pointer, keyboard, and assistive-technology users? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is the Google Maps behavior unambiguous about query source, preserved location text, URL safety, and missing-location behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the event-first document-order requirements consistently keep settings, filters, and refresh utilities secondary across desktop, mobile, and all application states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-013]
- [x] CHK010 Are “application-provided copy” and user/deployment-provided content consistently distinguished so translation requirements do not mutate event data or configured branding? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Do the mutually exclusive panel, filter persistence, and feed/snapshot preservation requirements avoid implying that opening, closing, or clearing a panel changes the selected feed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can the German-language outcome be objectively evaluated across visible strings, accessible names, status messages, and date/time formatting? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK013 Can branding success and fallback behavior be objectively evaluated for configured, missing, blank, trimmed, long, and markup-like values? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK014 Can event separation, affordance visibility, map-link presence, and post-event utility placement be evaluated at desktop and 320 CSS-pixel mobile widths? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, SC-006, SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are requirements complete for event locations containing spaces, punctuation, non-ASCII characters, or markup-like text without introducing unsafe or empty links? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements complete for long or blank configured headings so the responsive layout has deliberate wrapping and fallback behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are keyboard focus and Escape-close expectations defined for both secondary panels and native event disclosures without requiring a focus trap? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-011, FR-014]
- [x] CHK018 Are recovery and deliberate-state requirements preserved for no feed, no snapshot, empty results, loading, failed refresh, and stale snapshot states in German? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, US4]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK019 Is the dependency on the existing runtime configuration generation path and optional config fields documented without introducing a second configuration source? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK020 Is the assumption that Google Maps search URLs are sufficient for free-form ICS locations documented and bounded without requiring geocoding or an embedded map? [Assumption, Research §Google Maps]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
